lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Te2Ir2 (reduced formula TeIr) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-42m (No. 121), with a unit cell containing four atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Ir and Te centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Ir is surrounded by 8 Ir and 4 Te, while Te is coordinated by 4 Ir and 8 Te, with neighbor distances ranging from 2.98 to 3.33 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ir and Te 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, though these do not assert an exclusive sharing type for all polyhedra.
